# braintrust_project (Resource)

Manages a Braintrust [project](https://docs.braintrust.dev/admin/projects). Projects are the top-level organizational unit in Braintrust, containing experiments, datasets, prompts, and more.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Create a basic Braintrust project
resource "braintrust_project" "example" {
  name        = "my-ml-project"
  description = "A project for managing ML experiments"
}

# Create a project with custom settings
resource "braintrust_project" "advanced" {
  name                   = "advanced-project"
  description            = "A project with custom comparison settings"
  comparison_key         = "input"
  baseline_experiment_id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the project.

### Optional

- `baseline_experiment_id` (String) The ID of the experiment to use as the default baseline for comparisons.
- `comparison_key` (String) The key used to join two experiments (defaults to `input`).
- `description` (String) Textual description of the project.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Date of project creation.
- `deleted_at` (String) Date of project deletion, or null if the project is still active.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the project (UUID).
- `org_id` (String) Unique identifier for the organization that the project belongs to.
- `user_id` (String) Identifies the user who created the project.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by the project ID.
terraform import braintrust_project.example 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
